# External Code Placeholder

Some foundation-model wrappers depend on upstream repositories that are not vendored in this release.

Expected optional layout:

- `external/Geneformer_code_only/`
- `external/UCE/`
- `external/scFoundation/model/`
- `external/stack/src/`
- `external/nicheformer/src/`

The core scBrain model does not require these external repositories.
